title: TakeawaySnitches
description: Snitches addon to the TakeawayGuard plugin.
body:
TakeawaySnitches allows groups to monitor their land, detect intruders, and create vast perimeter alert networks. Built on a high-performance asynchronous engine, this plugin handles thousands of logs with zero server lag.

Dependency Warning
This plugin is a module of the TakeawayGuard Ecosystem.
Requires: TakeawayGuard
It will NOT load without the core plugin installed.

TakeawaySnitches Adds:

Two Snitch Types
- Jukebox (Alert Snitch): Massive 23x23x23 detection radius. Scans for enemies and logs entries, exits, block breaks, block places, and kills. Sends instant alerts to your group and Discord server when an intruder is detected. Ideal for active defense.
- Note Block (Logging Snitch): Compact 11x11x11 detection radius. Silently records entry and exit logs without notifying the intruder or spamming chat. Perfect for secret bases or internal monitoring.

Polygon Perimeter Fields
- Place multiple Jukeboxes near each other to form a connected defensive network.
- Powered by a custom 2D Polygon Ray-Casting algorithm, the plugin draws an invisible "field" connecting your snitches. Anything that happens inside that custom shape is tracked!
- Visualize your defensive boundaries and Convex Hull loops with particles just by checking your logs.

Discord Webhook Integration
- Connect your group's snitches directly to your Discord server.
- Fires lightweight, beautifully embedded JSON alerts to your channel the second an intruder breaches your Jukebox perimeter.

Zero-Lag GUI & Smart Logs
- Inspect logs instantly. Player skins are fetched asynchronously in the background, ensuring your server never freezes.
- Logs feature clean, relative timestamps ("Just now", "5 hours ago") and automatically purge after 30 days to keep your database lean.

MySQL Backend
- Piggybacks off the TakeawayGuard database kernel for enterprise-grade data stability.

How to Use
1. Create a Group: You must be in a TakeawayGuard group (/tgg create <name>).
2. Enable Reinforcement: Turn on TakeawayGuard's auto-reinforce mode (/tgf).
3. Place the Block: Place a Jukebox (Alert) or Note Block (Silent). The plugin will verify the reinforcement and instantly auto-create a snitch locked to that exact group! (If you forget to reinforce it, you will get a warning and it will not record).
4. Link Discord (Optional): Run /snitch webhook <url> to route base alerts directly to your Discord server.
5. Check Logs & Visualise: Stand anywhere inside your snitch's radius or polygon field and type /snitch to open the log GUI and see your boundary particles.

Commands
- /snitch - Open the log GUI and show boundary particles (Must be standing inside your snitch's radius/field).
- /snitch webhook <url> - Link your group's Jukebox alerts to a Discord channel.
- /snitch list - List all snitches owned by your group (Coming Soon).
